sql: SELECT fiscal_year, basis, operate_income, parent_netprofit, deduct_parent_netprofit FROM income_statement WHERE report_type='年报' AND fiscal_year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025 ORDER BY fiscal_year
SELECT fiscal_year, basis, verified_against, operate_income FROM income_statement WHERE report_type='年报' AND fiscal_year=2021
SELECT basis, value, source_report, disclosed_date, page FROM official_key_figures WHERE fiscal_year=2021 AND item='operate_income' ORDER BY basis

SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.basis AS basis_2021, b.basis AS basis_2020, a.operate_income AS income_2021, b.operate_income AS income_2020, ROUND(1.0*(a.operate_income-b.operate_income)/b.operate_income,6) AS naive_yoy FROM income_statement a JOIN income_statement b ON b.report_type='年报' AND b.fiscal_year=2020 WHERE a.report_type='年报' AND a.fiscal_year=2021

SELECT ROUND(1.0*(o21.value-o20.value)/o20.value,6) AS yoy_original FROM official_key_figures o21 JOIN official_key_figures o20 ON o20.fiscal_year=2020 AND o20.item='operate_income' WHERE o21.fiscal_year=2021 AND o21.item='operate_income' AND o21.basis='原始披露'

SELECT fiscal_year, basis, ROUND(1.0*(operate_income-operate_cost)/operate_income,6) AS gross_margin FROM income_statement WHERE report_type='年报' AND fiscal_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2025 ORDER BY fiscal_year

SELECT fiscal_year, ROUND(1.0*total_liabilities/total_assets,6) AS debt_ratio, COALESCE(short_loan,0)+COALESCE(noncurrent_liab_1year,0)+COALESCE(long_loan,0)+COALESCE(bond_payable,0) AS borrowings_upper, COALESCE(lease_liab,0) AS lease_liab, monetaryfunds, total_liabilities, total_assets FROM balance_sheet WHERE report_type='年报' AND fiscal_year=2025

SELECT c.fiscal_year, c.netcash_operate, i.netprofit, CASE WHEN i.netprofit>0 THEN ROUND(1.0*c.netcash_operate/i.netprofit,4) END AS ocf_to_netprofit FROM cash_flow c JOIN income_statement i ON i.report_date=c.report_date WHERE c.report_type='年报' AND c.fiscal_year IN (2019,2023,2024,2025) ORDER BY c.fiscal_year
SELECT COUNT(*) AS periods, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(total_assets-(total_liabilities+total_equity))>1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unbalanced FROM balance_sheet WHERE report_type='年报'

WITH y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, begin_cce, end_cce, LAG(end_cce) OVER (ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_end FROM cash_flow WHERE report_type='年报' AND fiscal_year>=2016) SELECT fiscal_year, begin_cce, prev_end, ROUND(begin_cce-prev_end,2) AS diff FROM y WHERE prev_end IS NOT NULL AND ABS(begin_cce-prev_end)>1.0 ORDER BY fiscal_year
SELECT fiscal_year, official_disclosed_date, title, source FROM disclosure_calendar WHERE fiscal_year=2021
SELECT fiscal_year, aggregator_notice_date FROM income_statement WHERE report_type='年报' AND fiscal_year=2021

SELECT report_date, basis, operate_income, ROUND(1.0*(operate_income-operate_cost)/operate_income,6) AS gross_margin, parent_netprofit, deduct_parent_netprofit, invest_income FROM income_statement WHERE report_type='中报' AND fiscal_year IN (2025,2026) ORDER BY report_date

SELECT fiscal_year, invest_income, operate_profit, CASE WHEN operate_profit>0 THEN ROUND(1.0*invest_income/operate_profit,6) END AS invest_income_share FROM income_statement WHERE report_type='年报' AND fiscal_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2025 ORDER BY fiscal_year

SELECT CASE WHEN fiscal_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2022 THEN '2020-2022' ELSE '2023-2025' END AS span, ROUND(SUM(parent_netprofit),2) AS parent_netprofit_sum, COUNT(*) AS years, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT basis) AS bases FROM income_statement WHERE report_type='年报' AND fiscal_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
